_comment: THE DRAIN KILL OFF AN ASSEMBLED BLINK LOOP. Emiel ({3}: blink) + Peregrine Drake (ETB: untap
up to five lands) on a board of four lands worth seven mana a tap, so every iteration nets
mana and the loop is unbounded. Essence Depleter turns that mana into life loss at {1}{C} a
point -- it has no {T}, so unlike Shivan Gorge it is bounded by MANA rather than by untaps.
This fixture exists because for a while the loop ran and the sink did not get paid: the mana
piled up and the game was won on turn FIVE by attacking. SpendSurplusOnDrain had no caller,
and once wired it only works in ONE position -- after the iteration's own activation is paid
and after ApplyBlink's ETB has untapped the board again. Before the activation it starves the
loop (done=0); at the end of the loop only, the float has been eaten by the blink's generic
{3} and the surplus is in a colour the {C} pip cannot spend. See the gap-two section of
Paired with edf_blink_loop_cashes_gorge.json, which is the SAME board with the Gorge instead
and already won on turn 4 before this fix -- so the pair says the loop and the go-off count
were fine and only the drain's cashing was broken. Only win_turn is asserted: the iteration
count is a searched choice, so pinning the drain total would break on unrelated search work.
